title: Abaucin: a targeted antibiotic against Acinetobacter baumannii
summary: A model trained on about 7,500 compounds screened 6,680 new compounds in under two hours; of 240 tested in the laboratory, nine were antibiotics, including abaucin, which was effective against wound infections in mice. Activity is highly narrow (no effect on the other bacteria tested) and still preclinical.

evidence.tested: About 7,500 molecules were screened in vitro, a neural network predicted new compounds that were tested in the laboratory (about 240 tested, nine antibiotics), and abaucin controlled an A. baumannii infection in a mouse wound model.
evidence.unknown: The abstract states no explicit limitations; the press release says activity is highly narrow (no effect on the other bacteria tested) and the compound remains preclinical.
evidence.ai_role: A neural network trained on screening results predicted structurally new compounds active against A. baumannii.
